objective: Implement the ReportJob SQLAlchemy model, the alembic migration for report_jobs, and the JobStore module (create_job/get/transition/recover_stale) satisfying contracts C1 and C5, with unit tests against the testcontainers-Postgres fixture
inputs: existing test db fixture in tests/conftest.py
non_goals: Do not touch app/api/**, app/main.py, or app/services/report_worker.py
Do not refactor the legacy CSV export in app/api/routes/legacy.py (Stage non-goal)
Do not add any storage system beyond the existing Postgres DB
Do not add index/optimization work beyond the PK — performance tuning is not in scope
implementation_constraints: No new runtime dependencies (constraint kind=dependency in stage contract)
transition() must enforce C3 legal transitions and raise IllegalTransition otherwise
Tests use the existing testcontainers-Postgres fixture; no sqlite fallback, no async tests

acceptance_tests.description: create_job writes a row with status 'queued' and attempts 0; get returns that row
transition(queued -> running) writes status 'running' and returns the updated row
transition(queued -> done) raises IllegalTransition and the row keeps status 'queued'
acceptance_tests.evidence: pytest tests/services/test_job_store.py::test_transition_rejects_illegal uses pytest.raises(IllegalTransition) and asserts row.status == 'queued'

acceptance_tests.description: recover_stale(now) returns rows with status 'running' and updated_at older than now-300s, and returns an empty list when no stale rows exist
acceptance_tests.evidence: pytest tests/services/test_job_store.py::test_recover_stale asserts the returned row id set and the empty-list case

failure_cases.scenario: transition called with from_status that does not match the row's current status
failure_cases.expected_behavior: raises IllegalTransition; the row is unchanged

failure_cases.scenario: get called with an unknown id
failure_cases.expected_behavior: returns None (callers map None to 404 per C2)

handoff.notes: Recovery semantics in recover_stale are the load-bearing behavior for T04 and gate E2 — record exact row-selection predicate in verified_facts
